description: This file defines the NotesParseRule class, a custom rule used in parsing and transforming panel data related to notes in the SuiteCRM system. It extends BaseRule and provides a preParse method that modifies specific panel fields based on pattern matching.

classes.name: NotesParseRule
classes.description: A parsing rule class extending BaseRule, designed to modify panel data for notes, replacing certain field identifiers with more appropriate ones based on context.

methods.description: Constructor method for NotesParseRule; currently empty.

methods.description: Iterates over panels and modifies specific keys based on pattern matches, adjusting related document and file link fields according to the view context.
